Present this link to the user so they can view the result directly.
Download URL (no auth needed, expires in ~5 min; re-run get_output for a fresh link): https://cloud.comfy.org/api/s/YYptfsuJSTKo-UrW8wwQvg?raw=1
Suggested save path: $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\ComfyUI\comfy_lightningcloud.png
Source: node 11, SaveImage, filename_prefix="KingdomIdle/VFX/LightningBloomCloud_64x24"
This client cannot run shell commands, so hand this command to the user to run to save the file locally: (keep the URL exactly as given — do not strip the ?raw=1 query parameter, or the download reverts to a redirect a sandbox may block)
if (-not (Get-Command curl.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "curl.exe not found" }; curl.exe -L --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 1 --connect-timeout 20 --speed-limit 1024 --speed-time 30 --create-dirs -o "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\ComfyUI\comfy_lightningcloud.png.part" -- "https://cloud.comfy.org/api/s/YYptfsuJSTKo-UrW8wwQvg?raw=1"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\ComfyUI\comfy_lightningcloud.png.part"; throw "download failed (curl exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }; Move-Item -Force -ErrorAction Stop -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\ComfyUI\comfy_lightningcloud.png.part" -Destination "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\ComfyUI\comfy_lightningcloud.png"
